title: hexmesh validation results
description: validation/<case>/results.json: every level's numbers at full precision, or rounded from RESULTS.md where the run's own output is lost (task 0093; validation/tools/results.py).  No fields: nothing per cell.

n_arc.description: a hexmesh level's section counts (task 0098): divisions per quadrant arc

n_radial.description: the core's O-H radial cells (0 on an H core)

n_width.description: a rectangular core's divisions along each width edge

n_height.description: a rectangular core's divisions along each height edge

wall_s.description: seconds the level's run took, from its start to its write; a volunteer's as measured where it ran (task 0185); absent on older levels

cores.description: the solve's MPI processes (OpenMP threads for SU2), where the driver states them (task 0185)

solve_s.description: the solver's own clock (OpenFOAM's ClockTime), where the driver reads it (task 0185)

environment.description: the run's versions; for rounded levels, those RESULTS.md names

extra.description: case-wide values that belong to no level
